story_zh: 按照国际法律，大使馆必须保证签证申请的标准。李博士调查了所有信息，发现部分警察拒绝提供详细说明。由于严重压力，他推迟了讨论。律师支持他，因此他完全有信心。同时，他尊重亚洲国家的规定，重视责任，以严格态度进行工作。
story_pinyin: Ànzhào guójì fǎlǜ, dàshǐguǎn bìxū bǎozhèng qiānzhèng shēnqǐng de biāozhǔn. Lǐ bóshì diàochále suǒyǒu xìnxī, fāxiàn bùfèn jǐngchá jùjué tígōng xiángxì shuōmíng. Yóuyú yánzhòng yālì, tā tuīchíle tǎolùn. Lǜshī zhīchí tā, yīncǐ tā wánquán yǒu xìnxīn. Tóngshí, tā zūnzhòng yàzhōu guójiā de guīdìng, zhòngshì zérèn, yǐ yángé tàidù jìnxíng gōngzuò.
story_en: According to international law, embassies must guarantee visa application standards. Dr. Li investigated all information and found some police refused to provide detailed explanations. Due to serious pressure, he delayed the discussion. Lawyers supported him, so he was completely confident. At the same time, he respected Asian countries' regulations, valued responsibility, and carried out work with a strict attitude.
